_comment: This is your configuration file. The plugin connects to either SQL Server or PostgreSQL databases using
sqlcmd.exe or psql.exe respectively. Their configurations are stored in the 'sqlserver' and 'postgres'
objects in this file. If you don't need one, you may remove it or simply leave its 'servers' object empty.
The platform objects, 'sqlserver' and 'postgres', have the following attributes.
'delimiter' - (optional) the separator between columns in returned query results. Default: | (pipe)
'alignLimit' - (optional) the maximum allowable time in seconds to be spent aligning columns. Default: 5
The server object's name is used in the sqlcmd's -S or psql's -h parameter. It can be an IP address, a hostname,
or a named instance. The server object contains these attributes:
'order' - (optional) an integer used to move favorites to the top of the catalog in ascending order.
'marks' - (optional) an object containing a letters and their corresponding database names, used to quickly
navigate to a database in the Catalog using the nvim jump-to-mark commands. See :h 'a
'args' - (optional) arguments added to the command line. For example, SQL Server user ID and password is entered
with '-U':'user' and '-P':'password'. For a switch with no value, enter it like so: '-j':null.
